title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
Acme Agents builds agentic AI products for enterprise workflow automation.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents with Google ADK and LLM orchestration
  • Build RAG pipelines with vector search and embeddings on GCP
  • Ship Python and Java microservices integrated through Kafka
  • Integrate agents over A2A and MCP with enterprise platforms

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Strong Python, Java and Spring Boot
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG and AI agents
  • Docker, Kubernetes and GCP

Nice to have

  • LangGraph, Terraform

Compensation: 32-45 LPA. Hybrid, Bengaluru. Apply by emailing careers@acme-agents.example.com with your resume.
